notes.title: We're forced to postpone the release... Again😭
notes.notes:
Hey, sweeties! 

Sad news again: our latest build got rejected during the moderation, and now we're forced to wait for another week until the changes are revised, and we're allowed to upload it and share with everyone💔

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/75c057ad07ee46733cfe957af1d09e5834af2e94.png

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, please, bear with us in these tough times. The estimated date now is February 14, which seems pretty convenient in a way, doesn't it? 

Let's celebrate the St. Valentine's Day together then! Wish us luck with the current moderation happening.


And while we wait, please, take your time to check out the project we've recently announced:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/db8edd2b1a30f5a1a2378950df8df6c2dba04860.png

✨Getting Inside✨ is a light visual novel about dealing with demon's powers inside your own body and learning how to get each and every girl you meet on your path. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/83108b04f70b5590d5d0a7fb31ea60b646e47f9c.png

5 hours of a hot story packed with great animations, branched choices and many endings to get to. Are you truly the One who's ready to wield the power of Lust? Wishlist the game now and find out yourself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478920/

notes.title: A very special rehearsal - we're getting ready to release the girls!
notes.notes:
Hey sweeties! 

Hentai Stories is coming January, 30, are you ready to have lots of fun?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/da86e61857d3235de86435c7614401282d9ae86b.png

It's not long until the game releases, and we figured that you'd love to know a bit more about what's to [strike]cum[/strike] come. 

Let's take a look at how aspiring actors get their first serious roles and what happens behind the curtains.

Now, you get the drill - the guy wants to become an actor but has trouble getting roughed up, and his roommates are ready to help him with their OUTSTANDING skills. 

Charlie isn't a coward, he can handle two rehearsals with Annabelle and Beatrice, be it a tet-a-tet dialogue between hero and villain, or a full-scale double attack on the vigilant! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/e919f160ad79263d17131399ae531ea33c387bff.png

Annabelle has just a wardrobe for all of their dress-up games, I mean, rehearsals! It's Charlie's job to figure out how to disarm his sexy opponents and make sure the suits will still be usable afterwards. 

And, of course, he has to show that producer what he's capable of - he is going to become the best actor of all times or die cumming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/794299bdfe5556e69e88f3a8e7778eb4efc37c86.png

Don't forget to wishlist Hentai Stories and make sure you're ready for the release date! 

And while we're at it - Summer For You team just dropped a sexy calendar for you to use this year. It's free, it's somewhat modest (just kidding: it's not) and it's going to make your waiting a little bit more bearable. notes.title: DEMO UPDATE + IMPORTANT NEWS
notes.notes:
Hey sweeties! 

We hope you're getting ready for holidays. We're certainly ready - and we have lots of news for you! 

Firstly, please, welcome:

Hentai Stories Demo V.2! 

We've added one more story for you to try - it seems like some college student is desperate to get good grades! Is she really ready to do anything it takes to convince her professor that she's a very capable student and has some fantastic skills to demonstrate? Check out the story and find out yourself!

Secondly, let's move on to the upcoming release news. 

We're happy to announce that Hentai Stories is going to be voiced! Our girls are getting ready to find their voices, full of lust and desire, to get louder and needier than ever! Please, show them your support in the comments, so they don't shy away. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721134/8602d76d4c658a0a3ecdbfd424a153b0f4fc3cbe.png
